evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation No. 28 Institute”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists. The US Commerce Department listed it in December 2022 for acquiring and attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernization.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
